President Trump tried to take from Maryland what Maryland had already won – and he failed.

It’s time to stop the games and get to work building the FBI headquarters that our public servants deserve, where it belongs: in Prince George’s County, Maryland.
posts.summary: Opposes Trump's attempt to block FBI headquarters in Maryland

We found hundreds of state vehicles sitting idle, thousands of phone lines not being used, and vendors that were being paid too much for their services. 

That ends now. 

We’re cutting costs for Marylanders and putting that money where it’s needed – in our classrooms, our health care clinics, and in our communities.
